mission_10: Congratulations on completing the Feature Engineering chapter! You have built a comprehensive feature engineering pipeline that transforms raw customer data into a rich feature matrix ready for machine learning. You learned categorical encoding (one-hot and label), interaction features, binning, frequency encoding, and scaling. Feature engineering is often the most impactful step in the ML workflow. Well-crafted features can make simple models outperform complex ones. The techniques you have mastered here apply to virtually any tabular data problem. You are now ready to tackle dimensionality reduction and other advanced data processing challenges!
